roles.name: Aggregate Identity and Mutation Flow
roles.lens: Investigate the semantic ownership and provenance flow of identity-bearing arrays and nested tuple/array values across aliases, exact and unknown selector paths, member/index projections, whole-binding and element assignments, predicate/coalesce joins, callable arguments/results, and captured mutable cells. Compare the state carried by SemanticResolver (Use, AggregateImportOrigin, ProvenanceBinding, callable aggregate assignments) with TypedSemanticGraph and TypedSemanticProvenance. Identify broad architectural options for a shared abstract flow/provenance model, true ownership and mutation invariants versus over-strict findings, exact state/transfer/join interfaces and diagnostics, and a 3–6-step sequential recovery with independently gated assertion tests. Include file-overlap and owner decisions, evidence-backed uncertainties, and disagreements for cross-domain synthesis and red-team review; remain semantic-only and read-only.

roles.name: Callable State and Eager Initialization Flow
roles.lens: Map higher-order callable discovery and eager initialization semantics: source-order visibility of callable events, branch/coalesce state joins, whole versus selected aggregate function replacement, closure and captured-cell effects, positional parameter binding, returned callable identity, recursive-call guards, active versus completed declaration tracking, and transitive cross-module dependency/cycle detection. Review SemanticResolver, InitializationAnalyzer, TypedSemanticGraph, and Domain11SemanticTest for duplicated analyses, missing phase boundaries, conservative rejection, and source-order hazards. Brainstorm coherent semantic state models, exact callable/dependency invariants and interfaces, structured cycle evidence, sequential 3–6-subdomain recovery steps, independent gates and tests, file-overlap risks, and owner decisions. Return a distinct finding with facts versus hypotheses and explicit disagreement inputs for synthesis/red-team review; remain semantic-only and read-only.

roles.name: Contextual Typing, Composite Nil, and Contract Recovery
roles.lens: Audit bidirectional typing and publication validation for nested/composite #NIL contextual typing through arrays, tuples, blocks, conditionals, coalescing, equality, qualifiers, literals, conversions, and invariant composite contracts. Compare TypeChecker’s contextual synthesis with TypedSemanticProvenance’s independent reconstruction and TypedSemanticGraph’s immutability/topology invariants. Separate normative contract requirements from accidental over-strict checks, decide where a shared context/provenance abstraction is justified versus a deliberately separate typing helper, and outline exact state, invariants, interfaces, diagnostics, assertion tests, and independently gated sequential recovery steps. Cover architecture/scope/risk and file ownership/overlap, then provide a cross-domain synthesis position, disagreement ledger, and red-team questions without solving implementation details; remain semantic-only and read-only.
